MATCH (a:Service {name: $a}), (b:Service {name: $b}) CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: a, targetNode: b, relTypes: ['DEPENDS_ON'], weightProp: 'weight'}) YIELD path, pathWeight RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.name], pathWeight
MATCH p = (s:Service {name: $name})<-[r:DEPENDS_ON*1..8]-(x:Service) RETURN x.name, min(length(p)) AS hops ORDER BY hops, x.name
MATCH (s:Service {name: $name})<-[:OWNS]-(t:Team) OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Person {on_call: true})-[:MEMBER_OF]->(t) RETURN t.name, p.name
